query:
WITH
    lvl AS (
        SELECT
            wealth_level,
            COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM
            estishraf_llm_wealth_index
        GROUP BY
            wealth_level
        ORDER BY
            cnt DESC
    ),
    cum AS (
        SELECT
            wealth_level,
            cnt,
            SUM(cnt) OVER (
                ORDER BY
                    cnt DESC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
            ) AS cum_cnt,
            SUM(cnt) OVER () AS total
        FROM
            lvl
    )
SELECT
    wealth_level,
     ROUND(100.0 * cum_cnt / total, 2) AS cum_pct
FROM
    cum
WHERE
    ROUND(100.0 * cum_cnt / total, 2) - (100.0 * cnt / total) < 70
ORDER BY
    cum_pct
LIMIT 2
raw_question: ماهم أعلى مستويين من الثروة يغطيان ما لا يقل عن 70% من جميع الأسر؟ أظهر االمستوى و النسبة التراكمية
